title: web UI: persist the unsaved New task form as a draft
description: openEditor() calls form.reset(), so a half-written new task is lost if the dialog is closed or the page reloads. ../rais MeadsTaskDetail autosaves the in-progress add form to localStorage (body/type/priority) and restores it on mount, clearing it on successful create. Add the same draft persistence to the meads new-task form under a single localStorage key so accidental closes do not lose work; clear it on submit and on explicit cancel.
